title: Mobile's Excelsior Brass Band, Cootie Williams and the New Orleans beat
summary: Tiger Rag was the fastest tune; he describes the Excelsior band under Johnny Pope, the union's resistance to outsiders, Cootie Williams copying Sam Morgan and Punch, and the Gomez auditorium hiring New Orleans bands.
